# Handoff: The Caboclo Cup page redesign (v2, final copy)

**Prototype:** `design/prototype/js/cup.js` (route `#cup`), with styles in the "The Cup" block of `design/prototype/index.html`.
**Data for the prototype:** `design/prototype/final.js`, generated by `design/export-final.ts` from `src/lib/analytics/cabocloFinal.ts`, `data/leagues/caboclo/caboclo-final.json`, and Bruno's season rank in `data/leagues/caboclo/2019.json`.
**Replaces:** `src/app/[league]/caboclo-cup/page.tsx` (the current static page).

**Copy is final.** Port the text in `cup.js` verbatim, including headings, subtitles, card text, toggle labels and the one-liners in "three options". Template values (`${...}`) must come from the data, not be hard-coded.

This is a visual redesign. Do **not** change the formulas in `cabocloFinal.ts`. Two optional data fields were added by hand and are already on main: `teams[*].yahooFtPct` and `adds[]` (see "Data").

## Build approach

- Keep `page.tsx` as a server component. It loads the JSON and calls `finalTimeline(f, "matt", "jacob-g")` and `lastShotWhatIf(f, "matt", "jacob-g")`. It looks up Bruno Caboclo's `actualRank` from the 2019 season's `players`, then passes plain data to client components.
- Use d3 through the existing `useD3Chart` hook and `tt.ts` tooltips, matching `src/components/viz/*`. `FinalBroadcast` replaces `FinalShotChart`, and you can reuse its scales.
- Use the site's light theme tokens. The hero and the scoreboard are intentionally navy panels.
- **Reduced motion:** render every section in its final state. That means the ball resting off the rim, all cards flipped, every arena but MEM @ LAC dark, and the broadcast at shot 16/16.
- **Animations:** sections animate once when scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver). Replay buttons restart them.
- **The broadcast starts at tip-off, not at the end.** This is deliberate, so the ending isn't spoiled before the reader presses play. Reduced motion is the only exception.

### Chart annotations (section 4)
Each label appears only once playback passes its shot:
- "Holiday: 7 misses in 10 shots", under Holiday's last miss before Q4.
- "Bruno: 3 straight", to the right of his first Q4 make. It shows after his third make.
- "2:58 Holiday layup: ahead", above that shot.
- The end label, current FG% to 4 decimals, plus "1:50: the last shot" and a pulsing ring at 16/16.

Compute the counts and indices from the timeline. Don't hard-code 7, 10, 3 or 2:58.

The gold line is labelled "Klaw Leonard finished .46928328", with "Above the gold line, Jacob wins the title" above the plot.

### "One-twelfth of a basket"
This is display math only: `round((whatIf.made.pct − loser.yahooFgPct) / whatIf.margin)`, which equals 12. In words, it compares the losing margin with what one more made shot was worth (1/567). It is explained in "How we know".

### Dropped from v1
Remove these if they were already ported:
- The half-court shot map. Its angles were illustrative.
- The four callout cards. They're now chart annotations.
- The separate "Then he sat down" section. It's merged into section 5.
- The 905 and 10-day timeline steps.
- The Points and "The shot" hero tiles.

Do **not** claim a substitution time. The play-by-play confirms 1:50 was his last shot, and the page only says that.

## Data (already on main)
- `teams[*].yahooFtPct`: .757 (Klaw Leonard) and .816 (Skip), from the Yahoo matchup page.
- `adds[]`: Yahoo transaction log for Mar 30–31, 2019, times in Eastern:
  - Skip adds Bruno Caboclo, Sat 7:47 pm.
  - Skip adds Justin Holiday, Sat 7:56 pm.
  - Klaw Leonard adds Christian Wood, Sun 3:00 am.
  - Skip adds Miles Bridges, Sun 10:45 am.
- Both fields are optional on the `CabocloFinal` type. If `scripts/capture-caboclo-final.mjs` regenerates the JSON, it must keep them.

## Done when
- `/caboclo/caboclo-cup` renders all 6 sections in this order with no console errors.
- The numbers match `cabocloFinal.ts`.
- Reduced motion shows final states.
- It builds on Vercel.
